Code: BR-009    Version: 1.0 Base Flour:  415g MFC: 10% Dough: MSD1
Test1: reduce sugar to 25%. 2.5% cinnamon is good. May be also try 3% cinnamon.
Test 2026-07-09: baked 20 min. Crust a bit crisp, crumb somewhat drier than wanted. Ok but aiming softer/moister.
Next: bake 18 min at 165C, fan 1. Glaze with milk and sugar. Cover loosely for first 5 min out of the oven to soften crust.

Spread was insufficient. Fix: cream butter + sugar + cinnamon into a smooth spreadable paste (butter at room temp, soft not melted) and spread evenly; roll dough slightly thicker, less in length and more in width to have more spirals. May be 2 inch each, so total 12inch in length.

Anti-unwind: leave 1in bare (no filling) strip at far edge and brush with water; roll snug with thin even filling; pinch seam and place seam-down and touching in tin; cut with floss/sharp knife; proof well; bake 165C (avoid too-hot start).

Chill to roll: after bulk/first proof, shape rectangle then chill approx 30-60 min so dough is firm and easy to roll. Then fill, roll, cut, and do the FINAL proof in the tin before baking (do not full-proof before rolling).
